svg.title: Serverless is cheap until a number you can compute
svg.desc: A log-log chart with a rising Lambda cost line passing $0.10 at a thousand requests a day and $9.73 at a hundred thousand, crossing a flat $12.26 always-on VM line at a circled 126,000 requests per day, beside an inset of cold-start bars falling from 8.7 seconds at 2,100 MB to 1.9 seconds at 280 MB and a second inset where latency falls from 152 to 27 milliseconds as memory rises while cost stays nearly flat, plus crossed-out boxes for provisioned concurrency at $21.90 a month and for GPU models.
svg.text: Serverless is cheap until a number you can compute
